not_extracted.item: Airspeed calibration points below 50 KIAS (all flap settings), above 110 KIAS (flaps up), above 90 KIAS (flaps 10 deg) and above 80 KIAS (flaps 30 deg)

not_extracted.reason: Not needed: Exercise 01 has no alternate-static case.

not_extracted.reason: Not needed now; Exercise 01 proposes bank up to 30 deg but no bank-dependent stall criterion.

not_extracted.reason: Only the points bracketing EDFE elevation (sea level and 1000 ft) and ISA (10 and 20 deg C) at maximum weight are needed.
